purpose: 参数填写和实现检查表；不能直接作为现有 YAML 加载

status_legend.已有YAML: 现有解析器已支持；按对应模型或检索配置填写
status_legend.已有代码参数: 构造函数/策略对象已支持；尚需接配置和依赖注入
status_legend.企业侧合同: 从平台获得并冻结；不能根据本地模拟猜测
status_legend.待实现: 需要先增加配置Schema、行为实现与测试

rules: 所有 user_fill 留空，由使用者填写；密钥只填环境变量名或密钥引用，不能填写密钥值。
已有配置 extra=forbid；待实现字段不能直接塞进当前模型/检索 YAML。
首版统一模型、切片版本和索引类型，三集合预加载；逻辑分层不保证延时排序。
本文是实施建议，企业参数和生产架构尚未据此变更。

1_enterprise_connections.name: content_source_contract
1_enterprise_connections.meaning: 正文/发布时间/版本或有序修订号/撤稿/分页游标
1_enterprise_connections.constraint_or_decision: 明确重复、乱序、更正、撤稿与游标过期语义；更新时间不能单独充当版本

1_enterprise_connections.name: embedding_endpoint_and_route
1_enterprise_connections.meaning: 模型接口及固定模型路由；只记录api_key_env名称
1_enterprise_connections.constraint_or_decision: 企业环境 provider=openai_compatible；现有模型文件还要求inference/prompts，保留原合同

1_enterprise_connections.name: postgres_test_database
1_enterprise_connections.meaning: 隔离测试库、账号与连接预算
1_enterprise_connections.constraint_or_decision: 可进行本项目版本化迁移；只记录密钥引用

1_enterprise_connections.name: milvus_connection
1_enterprise_connections.constraint_or_decision: uri中不带凭据；版本、权限、配额、索引支持向平台确认

1_enterprise_connections.name: milvus_collections
1_enterprise_connections.constraint_or_decision: 名称不同；字段匹配adapter，手动chunk_id主键，维度和度量一致；新增投影字段需迁移Schema

1_enterprise_connections.name: temporal_namespace_queue
1_enterprise_connections.meaning: 复用已有Temporal，新增索引工作流与Worker队列
1_enterprise_connections.implementation_status: 企业侧合同 + 待实现工作流
1_enterprise_connections.constraint_or_decision: 调度成功不等于索引完成；PG任务状态可被恢复派发

1_enterprise_connections.name: test_tenant_and_monitoring
1_enterprise_connections.meaning: 可信测试租户、日志/指标/告警入口
1_enterprise_connections.constraint_or_decision: 隔离数据和写权限；缓存命中也须过状态校验

2_vector_identity_and_chunking.name: embedding_revision
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.meaning: 权重revision、预处理、归一化规则及query/document前缀
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.implementation_status: 企业侧合同 + 待实现完整身份绑定
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.constraint_or_decision: 相同维度不代表兼容；服务路由若静默换模型必须阻止混用

2_vector_identity_and_chunking.name: expected_embedding_dimensions
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.constraint_or_decision: 代码允许1..65536；必须等于模型实际维度和collection维度，不是性能调参旋钮

2_vector_identity_and_chunking.name: metric_type
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.constraint_or_decision: 与已建索引一致；IP和COSINE只有满足归一化约定时才可对应

2_vector_identity_and_chunking.name: chunk_chars_and_overlap
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.meaning: 确定性切片长度和重叠
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.constraint_or_decision: chunk_chars>0且0<=overlap<chunk_chars；字符数不是token数，标题/前缀也计入模型输入预算

2_vector_identity_and_chunking.name: chunking_version
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.meaning: 切片器/清洗/标题拼接规则版本
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.implementation_status: 待实现：投影身份与chunk_id纳入此版本
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.constraint_or_decision: 改变规则需要新投影，不能复用旧切片编号覆盖旧内容

2_vector_identity_and_chunking.name: embedding_batch_size
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.implementation_status: 已有YAML：embedding.max_batch_size；现有PG工厂将其接到入库批次
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.constraint_or_decision: YAML允许1..2048但服务可能更小；同时满足token、条数、维度和当前HTTP响应1MiB上限；查询端当前不自动拆批

2_vector_identity_and_chunking.name: embedding_token_budgets
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.implementation_status: 企业侧合同 + 待实现切片后的token预算检查
2_vector_identity_and_chunking.constraint_or_decision: 不得静默截断导致正文缺失；超限需重新切片并记录规则版本

3_lifecycle.name: hot_age_boundary
3_lifecycle.meaning: 未显式提升时HOT的年龄上界Th

3_lifecycle.name: cold_age_boundary
3_lifecycle.meaning: 未显式提升时COLD的年龄下界Tc
3_lifecycle.constraint_or_decision: WARM为Th<=age<Tc，COLD为age>=Tc；边界无重叠无缺口

3_lifecycle.name: unknown_or_future_time_policy
3_lifecycle.meaning: 缺失或未来发布时间的处理
3_lifecycle.constraint_or_decision: 单独待核验，不伪造日期或默认为冷层；记录排除量

3_lifecycle.name: reheat_hold_and_cooldown
3_lifecycle.meaning: 显式回热事件后的保持期及再次迁移冷却期
3_lifecycle.constraint_or_decision: 首版回放确定性提升事件；后续接Python/SQL热度规则，抑制反复搬迁

3_lifecycle.name: migration_interval_and_batch
3_lifecycle.meaning: 扫描频率与每批迁移文章数
3_lifecycle.constraint_or_decision: 过快增加竞争和服务负载；过慢增加层级滞后；时间和批大小分别填写

3_lifecycle.name: visibility_consistency_and_deadline
3_lifecycle.meaning: 写入后及后续查询的可见性保证
3_lifecycle.implementation_status: 企业侧合同 + 待实现一致性参数传递/校验
3_lifecycle.constraint_or_decision: ACK或contains不等于Search可见；跨进程读者必须能继承同等可见性保证，不能只验证写客户端Session

3_lifecycle.name: content_correction_policy
3_lifecycle.meaning: 更正接受后旧版能否继续服务
3_lifecycle.implementation_status: 待实现；建议首版严格阻断旧版
3_lifecycle.constraint_or_decision: PG先提升最低可服务版本，新版未就绪时该新闻暂不可用；测量此空窗

4_recall_and_index.name: index_type_M_efConstruction
4_recall_and_index.meaning: HNSW连接数M和构建搜索宽度efConstruction
4_recall_and_index.implementation_status: 企业侧建索引参数；不是当前搜索YAML字段
4_recall_and_index.constraint_or_decision: 首版各层相同；调大通常增加内存/构建成本，变更按服务规则重建索引

4_recall_and_index.name: candidate_limit
4_recall_and_index.meaning: 融合阶段的候选新闻上限
4_recall_and_index.constraint_or_decision: 与最终证据条数以及单层切片limit区分；上层仍可能再过滤截断

4_recall_and_index.name: per_tier_limit
4_recall_and_index.meaning: 每层请求的向量命中数量
4_recall_and_index.constraint_or_decision: 实际limit=max(per_tier_limit,candidate_limit)；去重/状态过滤后可能不足篇数

4_recall_and_index.name: ef
4_recall_and_index.constraint_or_decision: 至少满足部署版本对实际单层limit的约束；调大常提高近似召回并增加耗时；当前三层共用

4_recall_and_index.name: rrf_k_and_weights
4_recall_and_index.constraint_or_decision: rrf_k不是TopK；权重改变排名，不自动减少该层耗时；迁移双副本须按有效层过滤后融合

4_recall_and_index.name: refill_budget
4_recall_and_index.meaning: 状态过滤与新闻去重不足时扩大候选的上限
4_recall_and_index.constraint_or_decision: 设置总deadline和最大候选预算；达到上限返回真实不足，不拿旧稿补足

4_recall_and_index.name: query_routing_mode
4_recall_and_index.meaning: 首版三层并发全查，后续才评估按条件查冷层
4_recall_and_index.implementation_status: 已有并发核心；聊天入口需统一
4_recall_and_index.constraint_or_decision: 三层并发总耗时受慢层影响；跳过冷层需独立评测召回损失

5_timeouts_and_capacity.name: embedding_timeout_seconds
5_timeouts_and_capacity.constraint_or_decision: 代码允许>0且<=300；单请求预算仍需扣除排队/检索/校验

5_timeouts_and_capacity.name: vector_timeout_seconds
5_timeouts_and_capacity.constraint_or_decision: 代码允许>0且<=60；search显式传递，写入/检查/删除需补全deadline语义；当前各层共用

5_timeouts_and_capacity.name: request_deadline_seconds
5_timeouts_and_capacity.constraint_or_decision: 覆盖排队+Embedding+max(各层检索)+PG校验+融合；重试共享剩余预算

5_timeouts_and_capacity.name: query_and_ingest_concurrency
5_timeouts_and_capacity.meaning: 在线查询与后台索引的独立资源上限
5_timeouts_and_capacity.implementation_status: 已有每批max_query_concurrency；全局/进程/企业限流待实现
5_timeouts_and_capacity.constraint_or_decision: 一条查询可发三次层级请求；批内semaphore不能代替跨请求全局限制

5_timeouts_and_capacity.name: activity_timeouts_and_retry
5_timeouts_and_capacity.meaning: StartToClose单次、ScheduleToClose含重试总预算、退避及最大尝试
5_timeouts_and_capacity.implementation_status: Temporal已有能力；新索引工作流待接
5_timeouts_and_capacity.constraint_or_decision: 只重试暂时错误；schema/维度/权限错误分类处理；避免SDK/Activity多层重试相乘

5_timeouts_and_capacity.name: heartbeat_and_checkpoint
5_timeouts_and_capacity.meaning: 长任务存活信号和可恢复进度
5_timeouts_and_capacity.constraint_or_decision: 按已完成批次持久化；任务重试能重复执行；每篇新闻用generation做条件激活

5_timeouts_and_capacity.name: postgres_pool_budget
5_timeouts_and_capacity.meaning: API/Worker各进程连接池和数据库总配额
5_timeouts_and_capacity.constraint_or_decision: 考虑所有副本及迁移/监控预留；远程Embedding/向量调用不占用长DB事务

6_test_and_acceptance.name: replay_fixture_and_seed
6_test_and_acceptance.meaning: 固定事件文件与查询集版本
6_test_and_acceptance.constraint_or_decision: 包含新增、更正、撤稿、降层、回热、重复、乱序、故障；每轮重置隔离状态

6_test_and_acceptance.name: virtual_clock
6_test_and_acceptance.meaning: 控制新闻年龄的固定业务时间
6_test_and_acceptance.constraint_or_decision: 只改变分层判断；耗时用真实单调时钟，不能用虚拟时间计算RPC延时

6_test_and_acceptance.name: workload
6_test_and_acceptance.constraint_or_decision: 每次只变一个维度；报告实际到达率/完成率/排队，不只报告成功请求延时

6_test_and_acceptance.name: latency_and_freshness_slos
6_test_and_acceptance.meaning: 端到端p95/p99、各层耗时、更新可见、撤稿屏蔽、失败和恢复预算
6_test_and_acceptance.implementation_status: 使用者约定，待测试实现
6_test_and_acceptance.constraint_or_decision: 样本量不足不宣称可靠p99；撤稿按PG提交后新发起查询判定；空结果/缺层另统计

6_test_and_acceptance.name: quality_protocol
6_test_and_acceptance.meaning: 人工相关性与ANN近似误差分开
6_test_and_acceptance.implementation_status: 已有单层ANN工具；三层及人工相关性需接协议
6_test_and_acceptance.constraint_or_decision: 精确基线使用同模型、同数据快照、同租户/版本过滤；向量自查询不能替代语义质量

6_test_and_acceptance.name: resource_or_fault_experiments
6_test_and_acceptance.meaning: 资源/索引参数变化与故障延时注入
6_test_and_acceptance.implementation_status: 待实现，可在稳定基线后单独运行
6_test_and_acceptance.constraint_or_decision: 同资源三集合不保证HOT快于COLD；sleep/网络延时注入只证明预算和故障处理，不能宣称索引性能

implementation_gates: G1：固定模型身份；一篇文档由真实Embedding生成向量，隔离Milvus集合可检索。
G2：PG同事务保存事件/状态/job；派发失败可恢复，游标不跳过未保存事件；Worker切片/Embedding/写目标/可见性校验/条件激活。
G3：统一查询入口；有效版本、投影、层及撤稿Gate通过，跨层重复副本不重复计分。
G4：更正/撤稿/降层/回热；迁移复制并验证→PG条件切有效层→精确清理旧投影；旧任务不能重新激活。
G5：在派发、写入、激活、清理边界中断Worker；重放重复/乱序事件；验证重启和断连恢复。
G6：固定查询集混合负载；报告参数版本、各层数据量、延时、质量、新鲜度与积压。
